title: Nanak, The Lowly, Says Embrace Love For
summary: The shabad does not leave ego at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: Nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord
lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: So serve the One Lord, with loving awareness; nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: So serve the One Lord, with loving awareness; nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord
evidence.turn: Ego steadies when nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord.
evidence.practicalImplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
